camel_example: aliyun rds ModifyPGHbaConfig --region cn-hangzhou --HbaItem.1.Mask 0 --HbaItem.1.Database all --HbaItem.1.PriorityId 2 --DBInstanceId 'pgm-bp1lymyn1v3i0000' --HbaItem.1.Address '0.0.0.0/0' --HbaItem.1.Type host --HbaItem.1.Method ldap --OpsType add --HbaItem.1.Option 'ldapserver=192.168.XX.XX_ldapbasedn=_CN=Users,DC=pgsqldomain,DC=net_ldapbinddn=_CN=pgadminuser,CN=Users,DC=pgsqldomain,DC=net_ldapbindpasswd=_Test123!_ldapsearchattribute=_sAMAccountName' --HbaItem.1.User ldapuser
description_en: Modifies the pg_hba.conf file of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS PostgreSQL实例的pg_hba.conf文件配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-pg-hba-config --db-instance-id pgm-bp1lymyn1v3i0000 --ops-type add --hba-item Type=host User=ldapuser Address=0.0.0.0/0 Database=all Mask=0 Option=ldapserver=192.168.XX.XX_ldapbasedn=_CN=Users,DC=pgsqldomain,DC=net_ldapbinddn=_CN=pgadminuser,CN=Users,DC=pgsqldomain,DC=net_ldapbindpasswd=_Test123!_ldapsearchattribute=_sAMAccountName Method=ldap PriorityId=2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPGHbaConfig

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The method that you use to modify the pg_hba.conf file. Valid values:

add: adds one or more records. If you use this method, make sure that the value of the PriorityId parameter for each new record is different from the value of the PriorityId parameter for any existing record.
delete: deletes one or more records. If you use this method, the record that corresponds to the specified value of the PriorityId parameter is deleted from the pg_hba.conf file.
modify: modifies one or more records. If you use this method, the record that corresponds to the specified value of the PriorityId parameter is modified.
update: overwrites the existing configuration in the pg_hba.conf file by using the new configuration
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型，支持以下几种方式修改AD域服务信息。
add：添加一条或多条记录，不能与已有PriorityId参数重复。
delete：删除一条或多条记录，将删除当前配置中PriorityId参数取值对应的记录。
modify：修改一条或多条记录，将修改当前配置中PriorityId参数取值对应的记录。
update：全量更新，将使用传入的配置覆盖当前配置
parameters.name: ops_type

fields.help_en: The IP addresses from which the specified users can access the specified databases. If you set this parameter to 0.0.0.0/0, the specified users are allowed to access the specified databases from all IP addresses
fields.help_zh: 允许用户从哪个或哪些IP访问数据库，0.0.0.0/0表示允许用户从任意IP地址访问数据库
fields.name: address

fields.help_en:
The name of the database. If you set this parameter to all, the specified users are allowed to access all databases on the instance.

If you specify multiple entries, separate the entries with commas (,)
fields.help_zh:
数据库名。表示允许用户访问的数据库，all表示允许用户访问所有数据库。

如果配置多个，可通过逗号（,）分隔
fields.name: database

fields.help_en: The mask of the IP address. If the value of the Address parameter is an IP address, you can use this parameter to specify the mask of the IP address
fields.help_zh: 掩码。如果Address为IP地址，可以通过此参数指定IP地址的掩码
fields.name: mask

fields.help_en:
The authentication method. Valid values:

trust
reject
scram-sha-256
md5
password
gss
sspi
ldap
radius
cert
pam
fields.help_zh:
认证方法。支持：
trust
reject
scram-sha-256
md5
password
gss
sspi
ldap
radius
cert
pam
fields.name: method

fields.help_en: The options of the authentication method. In this topic, LDAP is used as an example. You must configure this parameter. For more information, see Authentication Methods (https://www.postgresql.org/docs/11/auth-methods.html)
fields.help_zh: 认证方式对应的可选参数。本示例使用LDAP认证，需要配置。此参数的更多参数解释，请参见Authentication Methods (https://www.postgresql.org/docs/11/auth-methods.html)
fields.name: option

fields.help_en:
The priority of the record. If you set this parameter to 0, the record has the highest priority. Valid values: 0 to 10000.

This parameter is used to identify each record. When you add a record, the value of the PriorityId parameter for the new record must be different from the value of the PriorityId parameter of any existing record. When you modify or delete a record, you must also modify or delete the value of the PriorityId parameter for this record
fields.help_zh:
表示该条记录的优先级，取值范围：0~10000，0优先级最高。

此参数用于标识每条记录，新增记录时，不允许与已有记录重复。修改或删除时，需要与已有记录的PriorityId相同，用于匹配记录
fields.name: priority_id

fields.help_en:
The connection type.

Valid values:

host: The record matches TCP/IP connections, including SSL connections and non-SSL connections.
hostssl: The record matches only TCP/IP connections that are established over SSL.
hostnossl: The record matches only TCP/IP connections that are not established over SSL connections.

You can set this parameter to hostssl only when SSL encryption is enabled for the instance. For more information, see Configure SSL encryption for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance.[](~~229518~~)
fields.help_zh:
连接类型。

支持配置以下取值：
host：该条记录验证TCP/IP连接，包括SSL连接和非SSL连接。
hostssl：该条记录只验证通过SSL建立的TCP/IP连接。
hostnossl：该条记录只验证通过非SSL建立的TCP/IP连接。
如果使用hostssl连接类型，需要打开SSL链路加密，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/229518.html
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The user who is allowed to access the specified databases. You must specify the user that is used to log on to the RDS instance. If you specify multiple entries, separate the entries with commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 允许哪些用户访问数据库，填写实例的用户名。如果配置多个，可通过逗号（,）分隔
fields.name: user
